title: Fostering is drawn three times: which one is the feature?
detail: The owner approved fostering in Farrowing on 2026-11-03: Foster piglets from a living sow's Actions (Send / Receive) and Foster from selected piglets on a finished or dead sow's Piglets list (Send). The older RULINGS park and the 2026-10-10 sow-death-only scope are superseded for Farrowing. This fostering.* feature is still a draft based on the old Inspection UI and piglet-processing/move.html; Piglet processing's Move is another version. The remaining decision is which feature owns a shared cross-task fostering flow and how the three entrances reach it.
options: Keep the approved Farrowing entrances; this draft remains a historical placeholder
Make fostering.* the shared flow reached from Farrowing and Piglet processing
Make Piglet processing's Move the shared flow reached from Farrowing
recommendation: Use the approved Farrowing entrances for Farrowing. Keep fostering.* at its draft maturity until cross-feature ownership is decided on a canvas; do not point Farrowing back to the older parked flow.
